decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out below:Design and Access statement610 PL01, 610 PL01 A, 610 PL02, 610 PL03, 610 PL04, 610 PL05, 610 PL06, 610 PL07, 610 PL08, 610 PL09, 610 PL10, 610 PL11, 610 PL12, DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT   Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no external windows or doors other than those indicated on the approved drawings shall be installed in the development hereby approved without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

Prior to commencement of the development hereby approved, (including all preparatory and demolition work), the Arboricultural Method Statement within the submitted document ref. S1819- J1-R2 (prepared by John Cromars Arboricultural Company Ltd) shall be updated to include details of the following:Step by step demolition methodology of the existing outbuilding. Foundation design and a step-by-step installation methodology of the foundations, for the new outbuilding. Details of levels for the front garden, demonstrating that the finished levels of the new no-dig surfacing within the RPA of T6 are compatible with the finished levels of the surrounding new hard surfacing.Reason to ensure that retained trees are adequately protected through the preparatory, demolition, construction and landscaping stages of the development.

The development hereby approved shall strictly follow all details and working practices as set out in the arboricultural impact assessment, arboricultural method statement and tree protection plan prepared by John Cromars Arboricultural Company Ltd, ref. S1819-J1-R2 (as amended by Condition number 5).Reason to ensure that retained trees are adequately protected through the preparatory, demolition, construction and landscaping stages of the development
description: Single storey rear extension involving replacement of existing extension, front dormer, replacement tiles to existing rear dormer, replacement windows and new outbuilding to rear involving replacement of existing shed.
